tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: List feature requests for the connected FeatQ board.

tools.name: get_request
tools.description: Get one feature request with its comments for the connected FeatQ board.

tools.name: get_board_stats
tools.description: Get request counts, vote totals, and top requests for the connected FeatQ board.

tools.name: get_ranked_requests
tools.description: Get the top feature requests by demand score, excluding requests already marked done. tools.name: generate_spec
tools.description: Generate an agent-ready markdown implementation spec for one feature request.

tools.name: update_request_status
tools.description: Update the status of a feature request. Marking a request done makes it appear in the public changelog.
